messages:
Lena M.: Quick question from the offsite: host charged a $180 cleaning fee on the organizer's card after checkout. Host provided a PayPal transaction receipt (host nickname + tx id) but no invoice to the company. Two teammates spilled wine and team agreed to split the fee. Can we file this as actuals or should we treat it as an incidental? cc @people-ops
Maya (People Ops): Cleaning fees are reimbursable as part of lodging (actuals), not covered by meal per-diem. The original payer should submit the full charge and use the Attendees/Split field to apportion. If the host can't issue an invoice to Redwood, we can't reclaim VAT. Attach: Airbnb booking confirmation, PayPal/transaction screenshot, and a short note describing why the fee was charged.
Carlos (Finance): Add: for amounts > $75 we need corroboration (platform invoice, payout record, or manager approval). For platform bookings we often accept the Airbnb/VRBO invoice that shows booking details + host payout record. If only a PayPal stub exists, attach the PayPal transaction, host profile link, and the booking page PDF. Use FX rate on payment date for conversion.
Alice D.: The host gave a handwritten receipt after we asked. It has date & amount but no company name. Is that ok?
Maya (People Ops): Handwritten receipts accepted for reimbursement if legible and show date & amount. For VAT reclaim Finance needs an invoice in company name. If host won't reissue, submit actuals and flag "VAT reclaim"; Finance will review but set expectation: reclaim unlikely.
Lena M.: Host refunded $40 of the security deposit directly to Sam in cash at checkout. How should we show that?
Maya (People Ops): Original payer should include a negative line item on the expense for the refunded amount and note "cash refund to Sam on DATE". Attach a photo of the cash handover if available or a short attestation from the recipient. For refunds <= $50, photo + note is fine; > $50 Finance may ask for manager attestation.
Carlos (Finance): Workflow note: if one person paid and others owe shares, either the original payer submits and lists splits, or each teammate files a reimbursable expense referencing the original expense ID. Make sure amounts match and attach the same receipt. Mismatches slow approvals.
ExpenseBot: :receipt: Missing-receipt rules reminder: <= $25 use Lost-Receipt Form; $25-$75 need manager approval; > $75 original receipt required except Finance exception. Required fields: date, merchant (or platform), amount, currency. Preferred formats: JPEG/PNG/PDF.
Maya (People Ops): Helpful split template to paste into the description field:
```
Expense: Airbnb cleaning fee
Original payer: Lena M.
Split: Lena 30.00, Alice 30.00, Sam 30.00, Priya 30.00, Marco 30.00
Currency: USD
Notes: PayPal tx id XXX; booking confirmation attached; refund $40 to Sam recorded as negative line
```
Lena M.: Great, thanks everyone 44d I'll submit full charge with splits and attach PayPal + booking PDF. If Finance needs manager approval I'll ping my manager.
Alice D.: Saved the template 44d Thanks!"
